name: Silo V2

On April 3, 2026, Silo V2’s soUSDC managed vault on Arbitrum was exploited due to a misconfigured oracle and protocol logic flaws, resulting in about $392,000 in losses. The attack focused on a peripheral meta-vault, with stale or preset price data combined with errors in accounting and cap logic. A peripheral managed vault in Silo V2 on Arbitrum relied on an immutable, hardcoded oracle price for wstUSR, causing severe overvaluation of collateral after the asset depegged. This, together with protocol logic flaws in supply cap enforcement and asset accounting, allowed the attacker to extract excess funds.
